cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?
